rule: TRIAL_SCALAR: full trial metadata/status/costs/counters, never a per-bar object. CANDIDATE_COMPACT: required return/equity observations plus report support, trace REFERENCES not the trace itself. SELECTED_AUDIT: orders/fills/rejects/amends/cancels, account invariants, version/activation lineage, reconstructable path. CANDIDATE_COMPACT is a declared function of SELECTED_AUDIT (ra/retention.py::candidate_compact_from_audit), never an independently recomputed number.
known_gap: TrainingScorer._score (time_edge/execution.py) persists the FULL fills/commands/order_events for EVERY trial's candidate-*.json, not just trace references -- more than CANDIDATE_COMPACT specifies.
